title: PIXL 8000 Spearmint Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Spearmint delivers a classic Mint flavour that’s mellow and refreshing. Smoother than Peppermint, this flavour is ideal for vapers looking for a crisp, minty vape that’s not too intense. Each pod is filled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes with a 10ml refill reservoir. Used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, the setup supports up to 8000 puffs. Mesh coil technology helps deliver consistently clean flavour. MTL-compatible, draw-activated, and Boost Mode ready, Spearmint is a dependable choice for mint lovers who want a cool, easy vape.
